```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
meta <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "_meta")
# Drafted counts only the draft years already held, so the last year is complete.
last_draft <- meta$last_complete_nfl_draft
combine <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "combine") |>
  mutate(
    position_group = factor(combine_position_group(pos), pos_levels),
    drafted = !is.na(draft_round)
  )
combine_years <- range(combine$season)
# 2021 was cancelled, and its records are campus pro-day workouts (pro-day-year).
pro_day_year <- 2021L
combine_span <- paste0(combine_years[1], " to ", combine_years[2], " combines")
claim_fill <- position_palette()[["Quarterback"]]
context_fill <- "#9CA3AF"
# Named players, keyed on athlete id (decision 0013).
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who             , ~cfb_athlete_id , ~team           ,
  "Joe Burrow"     , "3915511"       , "LSU"           ,
  "Jordan Travis"  , "4360799"       , "Florida State" ,
  "Cam Ward"       , "4688380"       , "Miami"         ,
  "Shane Buechele" , "4039034"       , "SMU"           ,
  "Kyle Allen"     , "559681"        , "Houston"
)
team_colors <- team_color_values(DBI::dbReadTable(con, "teams"))

drafted_window <- combine |>
  filter(season <= last_draft) |>
  mutate(ran = !is.na(forty))
skip_pos <- drafted_window |>
  group_by(position_group) |>
  summarise(
    invitees = n(),
    skipped = mean(!ran),
    drafted_ran = mean(drafted[ran]),
    drafted_skip = mean(drafted[!ran]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- skip_pos |>
  mutate(
    is_claim = position_group == "Quarterback",
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: drafted %.0f%% when they ran the 40, %.0f%% when they skipped it",
      position_group,
      100 * drafted_ran,
      100 * drafted_skip
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = forcats::fct_rev(position_group))) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = drafted_ran, xend = drafted_skip, colour = is_claim),
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(x = drafted_ran, tooltip = tip, data_id = position_group),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    fill = "white",
    stroke = 1.6
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(x = drafted_skip, fill = is_claim, tooltip = tip, data_id = position_group),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = context_fill, `TRUE` = claim_fill), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = context_fill, `TRUE` = claim_fill), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Do invitees who skip the forty-yard dash get drafted less often than those who run it?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Drafted share, ",
      combine_span,
      "; open circle ran the forty, filled skipped it"
    ),
    x = "Drafted that year (2021 included)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "quarterback-skip-forty-drafted", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: quarterbacks
# Every quarterback invitee by season; an undrafted player sits at the bottom.
undrafted_y <- 290
qbs <- drafted_window |>
  filter(position_group == "Quarterback") |>
  left_join(subjects, by = c("athlete_id" = "cfb_athlete_id")) |>
  mutate(
    status = if_else(ran, "Ran the 40", "Skipped the 40"),
    pick = coalesce(draft_ovr, undrafted_y),
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s (%s), %s: %s; %s",
      player_name,
      school,
      season,
      if_else(ran, sprintf("40 in %.2f s", forty), "no 40 recorded"),
      if_else(drafted, sprintf("pick %s", draft_ovr), "not drafted")
    )
  )
cast_qbs <- filter(qbs, !is.na(who))
p_qb <- ggplot(qbs, aes(season, pick, colour = status)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = pro_day_year - 0.5,
    xmax = pro_day_year + 0.5,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "grey90"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(player_name, season)),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.25, height = 0, seed = 64),
    size = 2.8,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = cast_qbs,
    aes(fill = team),
    shape = 21,
    size = 6,
    colour = "#111827",
    stroke = 1.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = cast_qbs,
    aes(label = who),
    colour = "#111827",
    nudge_y = -18,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = team_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Ran the 40` = "#6B7280", `Skipped the 40` = claim_fill)) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = c(1, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, undrafted_y),
    labels = c(1, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, "Not drafted")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(combine_years[1], last_draft, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Where did each quarterback invitee go in the draft?",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Every quarterback invitee, ",
      combine_span,
      ", drafts through ",
      last_draft,
      "; the named players are filled in their school's color"
    ),
    x = "Combine year (shaded 2021: pro-day data)",
    y = "Overall pick",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_qb, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```
